summary_en: 10,000 shares (0.3% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥48.7M at closing price ¥4,870/share via ToSTNeT-3 on 21 Jul 2026. Execution method: single block order limited to one trading session. Reason: stable supply for stock grant trust (BBT) programme and operational capital policy flexibility.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Treasury Share Block Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: CEL Corporation's board on 17 July 2026 authorised acquisition of up to 10,000 treasury shares (0.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) totalling ¥48.7M. Execution is a single block trade on ToSTNeT-3 on 21 July 2026 at the closing price of ¥4,870/share. The buy order is limited to that trading session only; partial or full cancellation of the order is possible depending on market conditions. The stated purpose is twofold: to ensure stable procurement of shares for the stock grant trust (BBT) incentive scheme, and to maintain operational flexibility in capital policy in response to changing business environment. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 125,182 treasury shares against a total issued share count of 3,366,718 shares ex-treasury.
